lyrics:
[Intro: bouncing synth riff, marching snare, whistle blast]

[Verse 1: deep male baritone, ironic]
Eight o'clock, the doors divide
Left, right, coffee, stride
Navy fleece and zip to chin
Tap the card and you are in

[Chorus: full beat, group shout on the title]
Lanyard parade
Badges swinging in the sun
Lanyard parade
Everybody, everyone
Present arms: a reusable cup
Lanyard parade, line up

[Verse 2: baritone, sequencer busier]
Second floor is infantry
Fourth is the artillery
Colonel's got a standing desk
Medal for the fewest steps

[Chorus: full beat, group shout on the title]
Lanyard parade
Badges swinging in the sun
Lanyard parade
Everybody, everyone
Present arms: a reusable cup
Lanyard parade, line up

[Bridge: snare march only, spoken commands]
Badge in. (Badge in.)
Sit down. (Sit down.)
Reply all. (Reply all.)
Badge out. (Badge out.)

[Final Chorus: loudest, key up a step]
Lanyard parade
Badges swinging in the sun
Lanyard parade
Everybody, everyone
Present arms: a reusable cup
Lanyard parade, dismissed

[Outro: riff, turnstile beep, whistle]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 128 BPM, 4/4, A minor, up to B minor for the last chorus. A bright, bouncing march, EBM with a pop tune.

VOICE: Male baritone, deep, smooth and accented, sung with a straight face. A group of men shouts the title and repeats the commands in the bridge.

INSTRUMENTS: A bouncing, staccato analogue synth riff, a sequenced sixteenth-note bass, a four-on-the-floor kick with a military snare pattern, bright synth-brass chords, a referee's whistle, handclaps, a turnstile beep.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, riff, snare and whistle. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:38 Chorus 1. 1:04 Verse 2. 1:28 Chorus 2. 1:54 Bridge, commands. 2:14 Final chorus, key up. 2:44 Outro, riff, beep and whistle, ends 3:16.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2000s synth-pop EBM: clean, punchy and bright, sequencer tight, voice warm and forward.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Present arms: a reusable cup' at 0:56.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original teases the glamour of uniforms. The uniform most people actually wear is corporate casual, and the parade happens at eight every morning.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Brisk, amused, drilled, dismissed.
